title: Chicken potstickers with broccoli
skill: Steaming in a basket and in a covered pan

notes.1: Makes 24 potstickers, enough for 4. One skillet holds them all.

move.title: Steam two ways
move.body: Steam cooks food with the hot cloud above boiling water. Today you'll steam broccoli in a basket, then brown frozen potstickers and steam them in a covered pan. An adult is at the stove with you.

why.title: What steam does
why.body: Water boils and turns into steam. The steam is very hot, so it cooks food gently without the food sitting in water.

why.title: Lid away from you
why.body: Steam rushes out when a lid comes up. Lift the far side first, so the lid is a shield for your face.

why.title: Brown, then steam
why.body: The oil makes the bottoms crisp. The water turns to steam under the lid and cooks the filling through.

why.title: 165°F inside
why.body: Chicken filling is safe at 165°F. The thermometer tells you for sure.

wrong.sign: The broccoli is soft and dull green
wrong.fix: It steamed too long. Next time take it out at 4 minutes.

wrong.sign: The potstickers stuck to the pan
wrong.fix: Wait 2 minutes off the heat. Then slide the spatula under them.

wrong.sign: There's still water in the pan
wrong.fix: Leave the lid off 1 more minute so it cooks away.
Put the lid back on and steam 2 more minutes.

quiz.q: How do you lift a steaming lid?
choices: Far side first, away from your face

quiz.q: Where does the water go in a steamer?
quiz.explain: The food sits above the water.

quiz.q: How hot must the chicken filling be?
quiz.explain: Check one potsticker with the thermometer.

steps.text: Stir the soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sesame oil in the small bowl.
With an adult, cut the broccoli into bite-size pieces.
steps.tip: Same-size pieces cook at the same speed.

steps.text: Put the steamer basket in the pot. Pour in the pot's water. It should sit below the basket.
steps.look: Water under the basket, not over it.

steps.text: Put the lid on. Bring the water to a boil over high heat.
With oven mitts, lift the lid, far side first. Add the broccoli. Put the lid back on.
steps.tip: Keep your face back when the lid comes up.

steps.text: Turn off the burner. Lift the broccoli onto the plate with tongs. Sprinkle on the salt and cover it with foil.
steps.look: Bright green, with a little bite.

steps.text: Put the oil in the skillet. Heat it over medium heat for 1 minute.
Set the frozen potstickers in the pan, flat side down, in rows.
steps.tip: Use the tongs, and let go close to the pan.

steps.text: Wash your hands with soap, and wash the tongs.
An adult pours in the pan's water and puts the lid on right away.
Steam them with the lid on.
Lift the lid away from you. Cook with the lid off until the water is gone.
steps.look: No water left, and the bottoms crisp again.

steps.text: Push the thermometer into the middle of one potsticker. It needs to read 165°F.
steps.tip: Not there yet? Lid on, 2 more minutes.

steps.text: Turn off the stove. Serve the potstickers crisp side up, with the broccoli and the sauce.
